heapOrArchives.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.

scoreArea.title: Bioweapons Engineering
scoreArea.rulesText: Each source of meat damage inflicts +1 meat damage.

discardCards.title: Gypsy™ Schedule Analyzer
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, do not access any cards. Instead, reveal cards one at a time from R&D until you reveal an agenda card or there are no cards left in R&D. Store the agenda, if any, in HQ and shuffle the other revealed cards, if any, into R&D.

discardCards.title: Prearranged Drop
discardCards.rulesText: The next time you access an agenda this turn, gain [6].

discardCards.title: All-Hands
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, access three additional cards from HQ. You cannot use noisy icebreakers during the run.

discardCards.title: Promises, Promises
discardCards.rulesText: The next time you access an agenda this turn, score 1 additional agenda point.

discardCards.title: R&D-Protocol Files
discardCards.rulesText: A: Make a run on R&D, but instead of accessing cards, look at the top five cards of R&D.

scoreArea.title: Corporate War
scoreArea.rulesText: If you have [12] or more bits in your pool when you score Corporate War, gain [12]; otherwise, lose all bits.
